status_definitions.original_source_described: A specific primary publication or source record was desk-reviewed in the initial pilot. No original raw-file validation implied.
status_definitions.not_independently_reviewed: Only indexed catalogue metadata is available; no completed primary-source review recorded in Phase 2.
status_definitions.connected_drive_copy_inspected: A subset of actual file bytes was examined from connected storage; canonical origin and complete release coverage are not proven.
status_definitions.not_performed: No raw file bytes have been examined for this resource in this phase.
status_definitions.not_verified: No conclusive source/file or science-level evidence is recorded for the named check.
status_definitions.landing_ok: Landing page was reported reachable by independent link monitor; NOT proof of downloadable files or suitability.
status_definitions.landing_unverified: Host response (often 403/429) prevented automated confirmation; NOT necessarily inaccessible.
status_definitions.landing_broken: Link monitor flagged the source; requires original URL correction or manual verification.
